mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PASSWORD_RESET (TOKEN_HASH, IDENTIFY, EMAIL, EXPIRES_AT, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{tokenHash}, #{identify}, #{email}, #{expiresAt}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT TOKEN_HASH, IDENTIFY, EMAIL, EXPIRES_AT, USED_AT, CREATED_AT FROM PASSWORD_RESET WHERE TOKEN_HASH = #{tokenHash} AND USED_AT IS NULL AND EXPIRES_AT > SYSDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE PASSWORD_RESET SET USED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE TOKEN_HASH = #{tokenHash} AND USED_AT IS NULL
